The '''Ultaarian Greenback''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]], four-[[Limb/Legends|armed]], bipedal [[Species/Legends|species]]. Members of the [[Species/Legends|species]] had green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], a pink horn growing from the nose, large [[Tooth/Legends|fangs]], and pink skin. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Living windmill|member]] of the [[Species/Legends|species]] faced the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] in [[the Big Game]], a [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] combat on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]]. The four-limbed [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] wielded a [[dagger thorn]] in each hand during the bout.<ref name="SW20" />
